in_sanskrit.name: Potti
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lotus
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Potti एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Potti is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Padma' which means lotus. It is a unisex name with deep spiritual significance in Hinduism. It represents blessings, strength, and the purity and divinity of the lotus flower.
